IDS_ENABLE_DEBUGGING_HELP.en:
BEGIN_H3Debugging FeaturesEND_H3
          BR
          You can enable the debugging features on your NickelOS device in order to install and test custom code on your device.  This will allow you to:BR
          BEGIN_LIST
            LIST_ITEMRemove rootfs verification so you can modify OS files
            LIST_ITEMEnable SSH access to the device using the standard test keys so you can use tools such as BEGIN_CODE'cros flash'END_CODE to access the device
            LIST_ITEMEnable booting from USB so you can install an OS image from a USB drive
            LIST_ITEMSet both the dev and the system root login password to a custom value so you can manually SSH into the device
          END_LIST
          BR
          Once enabled, most of the debugging features will remain enabled even after performing a powerwash or wiping the data on an enterprise managed device.  To fully disable all debugging features, reinstall NickelOS.
          BR
          BR
          For more information about the debugging features see:BR
          https://www.chromium.org/chromium-os/how-tos-and-troubleshooting/debugging-features
          BR
          BR
          BEGIN_BOLDNote:END_BOLD  The system will reboot during the process.
IDS_ENABLE_DEBUGGING_HELP.t:
BEGIN_H3Značajke za otklanjanje pogrešakaEND_H3
          BR
          Na NickelOS uređaju možete omogućiti značajke za otklanjanje pogrešaka kako biste instalirali i testirali prilagođeni kôd na uređaju. To će vam omogućiti sljedeće:BR
          BEGIN_LIST
            LIST_ITEMuklanjanje potvrde rootfs radi izmjene datoteka OS-a
            LIST_ITEMomogućivanje SSH pristupa uređaju pomoću standardnih testnih ključeva kako biste mogli upotrebljavati alate kao što je BEGIN_CODEcros flashEND_CODE za pristup uređaju
            LIST_ITEMomogućivanje pokretanja s USB-a kako biste mogli instalirati sliku OS-a s USB diska
            LIST_ITEMpostavljanje dev i sistemske korijenske zaporke za prijavu na prilagođenu vrijednost kako biste mogli ručno povezati uređaj pomoću SSH protokola.
          END_LIST
          BR
          Kada ih omogućite, većina značajki za otklanjanje pogrešaka ostat će omogućene čak i nakon izvršavanja powerwasha ili brisanja podataka na uređaju kojim upravlja organizacija. Da biste potpuno onemogućili sve značajke za otklanjanje pogrešaka, ponovno instalirajte NickelOS.
          BR
          BR
          Više informacija o značajkama za otklanjanje pogrešaka potražite na stranici:BR
          https://www.chromium.org/chromium-os/how-tos-and-troubleshooting/debugging-features
          BR
          BR
          BEGIN_BOLDNapomena:END_BOLD sustav će se ponovno pokrenuti tijekom postupka.

IDS_NICKEL_CAMERA_OFF_MESSAGE.en: APP_NAME wants to use the camera. To let it, turn on camera access in Privacy controls.
IDS_NICKEL_CAMERA_OFF_MESSAGE.t: APP_NAME želi upotrebljavati fotoaparat. Da biste to dopustili, uključite pristup fotoaparatu u kontrolama privatnosti.

IDS_NICKEL_GLOBAL_SHORTCUTS_HINT.en: To change a shortcut, select its keys and press new ones. Backspace removes it.
IDS_NICKEL_GLOBAL_SHORTCUTS_HINT.t: Da biste promijenili prečac, odaberite njegove tipke i pritisnite nove. Tipka Backspace uklanja prečac.

IDS_NICKEL_GLOBAL_SHORTCUTS_MESSAGE.en: APP_NAME wants these shortcuts to work while you use other apps too. It learns only when you press them, not what else you type.
IDS_NICKEL_GLOBAL_SHORTCUTS_MESSAGE.t: APP_NAME želi da ti prečaci rade i dok upotrebljavate druge aplikacije. Saznat će samo kad ih pritisnete, a ne što još upisujete.

IDS_NICKEL_GLOBAL_SHORTCUTS_NEEDS_MODIFI.en: Use Ctrl, Alt or Search with the key, or a function key.
IDS_NICKEL_GLOBAL_SHORTCUTS_NEEDS_MODIFI.t: Uz tipku upotrijebite Ctrl, Alt ili tipku za pretraživanje ili upotrijebite funkcijsku tipku.

IDS_NICKEL_GLOBAL_SHORTCUTS_TAKEN.en: Those keys are already in use. Try others.
IDS_NICKEL_GLOBAL_SHORTCUTS_TAKEN.t: Te se tipke već upotrebljavaju. Pokušajte s drugima.

IDS_NICKEL_LOCAL_ACCOUNT_ERROR_FAILED_DE.en: Could not create the account: DETAIL.

IDS_NICKEL_LOCAL_ACCOUNT_ERROR_SIGN_IN.en: Could not set up the account: DETAIL

IDS_NICKEL_LOCAL_ACCOUNT_ERROR_TOO_LONG.en: Creating the account took too long. Try again.
IDS_NICKEL_LOCAL_ACCOUNT_ERROR_TOO_LONG.t: Izrada računa trajala je predugo. Pokušajte ponovo.

IDS_NICKEL_LOCAL_ACCOUNT_ERROR_USERNAME.en: Usernames start with a lowercase letter and use only lowercase letters, digits, - and _ (up to 32).
IDS_NICKEL_LOCAL_ACCOUNT_ERROR_USERNAME.t: Korisnička imena počinju malim slovom i sadrže samo mala slova, znamenke, - i _ (najviše 32).

IDS_NICKEL_LOCAL_ACCOUNT_PICTURE_SUBTITL.en: It shows on the sign-in screen and in the system tray. To use a photo of your own, go to Settings later.
IDS_NICKEL_LOCAL_ACCOUNT_PICTURE_SUBTITL.t: Prikazuje se na zaslonu za prijavu i na traci sustava. Ako želite upotrijebiti vlastitu fotografiju, kasnije otvorite Postavke.

IDS_NICKEL_LOCAL_ACCOUNT_SUBTITLE.en: Your account and its files live on this device, encrypted with your password. Without a Google account there is no way to recover them if you forget it.
IDS_NICKEL_LOCAL_ACCOUNT_SUBTITLE.t: Vaš račun i njegove datoteke nalaze se na ovom uređaju, šifrirani vašom zaporkom. Bez Google računa ne možete ih vratiti ako zaboravite zaporku.

IDS_NICKEL_LOCAL_ACCOUNT_USERNAME_ERROR.en: Start with a lowercase letter; use lowercase letters, digits, - and _ (up to 32)
IDS_NICKEL_LOCAL_ACCOUNT_USERNAME_ERROR.t: Počnite malim slovom; upotrebljavajte mala slova, znamenke, - i _ (najviše 32)

IDS_NICKEL_LOCATION_ACCESS_MESSAGE.en: APP_NAME wants to know where this device is, found from nearby Wi-Fi networks and its internet address. Your answer is remembered for this app.
IDS_NICKEL_LOCATION_ACCESS_MESSAGE.t: APP_NAME želi znati gdje se ovaj uređaj nalazi, prema obližnjim Wi-Fi mrežama i njegovoj internetskoj adresi. Vaš se odgovor pamti za ovu aplikaciju.

IDS_NICKEL_LOCATION_ACCESS_TITLE.en: Allow APP_NAME to use your location?
IDS_NICKEL_LOCATION_ACCESS_TITLE.t: Želite li dopustiti da APP_NAME upotrebljava vašu lokaciju?

IDS_NICKEL_LOCATION_OFF_MESSAGE.en: APP_NAME wants to use your location. To let it, turn on location access in Privacy controls.
IDS_NICKEL_LOCATION_OFF_MESSAGE.t: APP_NAME želi upotrebljavati vašu lokaciju. Da biste to dopustili, uključite pristup lokaciji u kontrolama privatnosti.

IDS_NICKEL_REMOTE_CONTROL_MESSAGE.en: APP_NAME wants to control this device's keyboard and pointer. Allow it only if you trust whoever is connecting.
IDS_NICKEL_REMOTE_CONTROL_MESSAGE.t: APP_NAME želi upravljati tipkovnicom i pokazivačem ovog uređaja. Dopustite to samo ako vjerujete osobi koja se povezuje.

IDS_NICKEL_SEARCH_ENGINE_CHOICE_INFO_DIA.en: You chose Minimal when you set up NickelOS, so no search engine was picked for you. These search engines are popular in your region and are shown in random order.
IDS_NICKEL_SEARCH_ENGINE_CHOICE_INFO_DIA.t: Pri postavljanju NickelOS-a odabrali ste opciju „Minimalno”, pa vam nije odabrana nijedna tražilica. Ove su tražilice popularne u vašoj regiji i prikazuju se nasumičnim redoslijedom.

IDS_NICKEL_SETUP_EITHER_WAY.en: Either way, you get Bazaar to find more apps, and apps to open your photos, videos, music and documents.
IDS_NICKEL_SETUP_EITHER_WAY.t: U oba slučaja dobivate Bazaar za pronalaženje novih aplikacija te aplikacije za otvaranje fotografija, videozapisa, glazbe i dokumenata.

IDS_NICKEL_SETUP_FULL_DESCRIPTION.en: Everything ready to go, and private. DuckDuckGo searches the web from the browser and the launcher, uBlock Origin blocks ads and trackers in the browser, Proton's private apps (Mail, Calendar, Drive, Pass and more) are installed, and free, open-source apps come with it: LibreOffice, OBS Studio, GIMP, Kdenlive and more.
IDS_NICKEL_SETUP_FULL_DESCRIPTION.t: Sve je spremno za upotrebu i privatno. DuckDuckGo pretražuje web iz preglednika i Pokretača, uBlock Origin blokira oglase i alate za praćenje u pregledniku, instalirane su Protonove privatne aplikacije (Mail, Calendar, Drive, Pass i druge), a dobivate i besplatne aplikacije otvorenog koda: LibreOffice, OBS Studio, GIMP, Kdenlive i druge.

IDS_NICKEL_SETUP_MINIMAL_DESCRIPTION.en: Just the basics. The launcher searches only this computer, and nothing else is set up for you.
IDS_NICKEL_SETUP_MINIMAL_DESCRIPTION.t: Samo osnove. Pokretač pretražuje samo ovo računalo i ništa se drugo ne postavlja umjesto vas.

IDS_NICKEL_SETUP_SUBTITLE.en: You can change all of this later in Settings.
IDS_NICKEL_SETUP_SUBTITLE.t: Sve ovo možete kasnije promijeniti u Postavkama.

IDS_NICKEL_SETUP_TITLE.en: How would you like to start?

IDS_OMNIBOX_PEDAL_MANAGE_CHROMEOS_ACCESS.en: Personalize your accessibility tools in NickelOS settings
IDS_OMNIBOX_PEDAL_MANAGE_CHROMEOS_ACCESS.t: U postavkama NickelOS-a prilagodite svoje alate za pristupačnost

IDS_OOBE_CHROMEVOX_HINT_ANNOUNCEMENT_TEX.en: Do you want to activate ChromeVox, the built-in screen reader for NickelOS? If so, press the space bar.
IDS_OOBE_CHROMEVOX_HINT_ANNOUNCEMENT_TEX.t: Želite li aktivirati ChromeVox, ugrađeni čitač zaslona za NickelOS? Ako želite, pritisnite razmaknicu.

IDS_OOBE_CHROMEVOX_HINT_ANNOUNCEMENT_TEX.en: Do you want to activate ChromeVox, the built-in screen reader for NickelOS? If so, press and hold both volume keys for five seconds.
IDS_OOBE_CHROMEVOX_HINT_ANNOUNCEMENT_TEX.t: Želite li aktivirati ChromeVox, ugrađeni čitač zaslona za NickelOS? Ako želite, pritisnite i zadržite obje tipke za glasnoću pet sekundi.

IDS_OOBE_CHROMEVOX_HINT_TEXT.en: Do you want to activate ChromeVox, the built-in screen reader for NickelOS?
IDS_OOBE_CHROMEVOX_HINT_TEXT.t: Želite li aktivirati ChromeVox, ugrađeni čitač zaslona za NickelOS?

IDS_OS_INSTALL_SCREEN_INTRO_CONTENT_0.en: Before starting, make sure you have a backup of your data. Installing DEVICE_OS will overwrite the disk you choose.
IDS_OS_INSTALL_SCREEN_INTRO_CONTENT_0.t: Prije nego što počnete, izradite sigurnosnu kopiju podataka. Instaliranjem OS-a DEVICE_OS prebrisat će se disk koji odaberete.

IDS_OS_INSTALL_SCREEN_INTRO_FOOTER.en: DEVICE_OS is free software provided as is: it may not work on every computer, and its authors are not responsible for any data loss.
IDS_OS_INSTALL_SCREEN_INTRO_FOOTER.t: DEVICE_OS slobodan je softver koji se pruža „kakav jest”: možda neće funkcionirati na svakom računalu, a njegovi autori nisu odgovorni ni za kakav gubitak podataka.

IDS_OS_SETTINGS_SYNC_FEATURE_LABEL.en: Your apps and settings will sync across all NickelOS devices where you are signed in with your Google account. For browser sync options, go to LINK_BEGINChrome settingsLINK_END.
IDS_OS_SETTINGS_SYNC_FEATURE_LABEL.t: Vaše aplikacije i postavke sinkronizirat će se na svim uređajima s NickelOS-om na kojima ste prijavljeni svojim Google računom. Za opcije sinkronizacije preglednika otvorite LINK_BEGINChromeove postavkeLINK_END.

IDS_OS_SETTINGS_SYNC_FEATURE_LABEL_2.en: Your apps and settings will sync across all NickelOS devices where you are signed in with your Google Account. To manage what browser data is saved in your Google Account, go to LINK_BEGINChrome settingsLINK_END.
IDS_OS_SETTINGS_SYNC_FEATURE_LABEL_2.t: Vaše aplikacije i postavke sinkronizirat će se na svim uređajima s NickelOS-om na kojima ste prijavljeni svojim Google računom. Da biste upravljali time koji se podaci preglednika spremaju na vaš Google račun, otvorite LINK_BEGINpostavke ChromeaLINK_END.

IDS_PERSONALIZATION_APP_AMBIENT_MODE_NIC.en: When your screen is idle, show your pictures, time, and media info
IDS_PERSONALIZATION_APP_AMBIENT_MODE_NIC.t: Kad je zaslon neaktivan, prikažite svoje slike, sat i medijske informacije

IDS_PERSONALIZATION_APP_AMBIENT_MODE_NIC.en: The screen saver shows the pictures in your Pictures folder and the folders in it. Add at least 2.
IDS_PERSONALIZATION_APP_AMBIENT_MODE_NIC.t: Čuvar zaslona prikazuje slike iz mape Slike i mapa u njoj. Dodajte barem 2 slike.

IDS_PERSONALIZATION_APP_AMBIENT_MODE_NIC.en: The screen saver shows NickelOS's wallpapers. Turn this on to show the pictures in My files > Pictures instead.
IDS_PERSONALIZATION_APP_AMBIENT_MODE_NIC.t: Čuvar zaslona prikazuje pozadine sustava NickelOS. Uključite ovu opciju da bi se umjesto njih prikazivale slike iz mape Moje datoteke > Pictures.

IDS_PERSONALIZATION_APP_AMBIENT_MODE_NIC.en: From Open-Meteo, for your approximate location, which beaconDB works out from your internet address
IDS_PERSONALIZATION_APP_AMBIENT_MODE_NIC.t: Od usluge Open-Meteo, za vašu približnu lokaciju, koju beaconDB određuje na temelju vaše IP adrese

IDS_PRINT_PREVIEW_PRINTER_SETUP_INFO_MES.en: Make sure your printer is turned on and connected to the same network as your NickelOS device or use a USB cable
IDS_PRINT_PREVIEW_PRINTER_SETUP_INFO_MES.t: Provjerite je li pisač uključen i povezan s istom mrežom kao NickelOS uređaj ili upotrijebite USB kabel

IDS_SETTINGS_ACCOUNT_BODY_CHROMEOS.en: When on, data is saved in your Google Account and can be used on all your devices. When off, data is saved only to this device. For NickelOS sync options, go to LINK_BEGINNickelOS settingsLINK_END.
IDS_SETTINGS_ACCOUNT_BODY_CHROMEOS.t: Kad je postavka uključena, podaci se spremaju na vaš Google račun i mogu se upotrebljavati na svim vašim uređajima. Kad je ta postavka isključena, podaci se spremaju samo na ovaj uređaj. Za opcije sinkronizacije NickelOS-a otvorite LINK_BEGINpostavke NickelOS-aLINK_END.

IDS_SETTINGS_APPS_ARC_VM_SHARED_USB_DEVI.en: Give Android apps control over USB devices on this NickelOS device. Permission will be requested each time you plug in a USB device. Individual Android apps will ask for additional permissions.
IDS_SETTINGS_APPS_ARC_VM_SHARED_USB_DEVI.t: Dopustite Android aplikacijama da upravljaju USB uređajima na ovom NickelOS uređaju. Dopuštenje će se tražiti svaki put kad priključite USB uređaj. Pojedinačne Android aplikacije tražit će dodatna dopuštenja.

IDS_SETTINGS_END_OF_LIFE_INCENTIVE_NO_OF.en: Your device is no longer receiving security and software updates.
IDS_SETTINGS_END_OF_LIFE_INCENTIVE_NO_OF.t: Uređaj više ne prima sigurnosna i softverska ažuriranja.

IDS_SETTINGS_END_OF_LIFE_INCENTIVE_NO_OF.en: This device no longer gets updates
IDS_SETTINGS_END_OF_LIFE_INCENTIVE_NO_OF.t: Ovaj uređaj više ne prima ažuriranja

IDS_SETTINGS_END_OF_LIFE_INCENTIVE_OFFER.en: Your device is no longer receiving security and software updates.
IDS_SETTINGS_END_OF_LIFE_INCENTIVE_OFFER.t: Uređaj više ne prima sigurnosna i softverska ažuriranja.

IDS_SETTINGS_END_OF_LIFE_INCENTIVE_OFFER.en: This device no longer gets updates
IDS_SETTINGS_END_OF_LIFE_INCENTIVE_OFFER.t: Ovaj uređaj više ne prima ažuriranja

IDS_SETTINGS_GUEST_OS_SHARED_USB_DEVICES.en: Give Android apps control over USB devices on this NickelOS device
IDS_SETTINGS_GUEST_OS_SHARED_USB_DEVICES.t: Dopustite Android aplikacijama da upravljaju USB uređajima na ovom NickelOS uređaju

IDS_SETTINGS_NEARBY_SHARE_DATA_USAGE_MOB.en: This option applies to NickelOS devices with a data plan or mobile network dongle, or when tethering to a portable hotspot
IDS_SETTINGS_NEARBY_SHARE_DATA_USAGE_MOB.t: Opcija se primjenjuje na NickelOS uređaje s podatkovnim paketom ili hardverskim ključem za mobilnu mrežu ili prilikom modemskog povezivanja s prijenosnom žarišnom točkom

IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_ACCOUNTS_ADD_PERSON_.en: You'll be signed out. On the sign-in screen, the new person chooses a name, a username and a password.
IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_ACCOUNTS_ADD_PERSON_.t: Bit ćete odjavljeni. Na zaslonu za prijavu nova osoba odabire ime, korisničko ime i zaporku.

IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_ACCOUNTS_ADMIN_BODY.en: Administrators can install software for everyone, change the system and manage accounts.
IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_ACCOUNTS_ADMIN_BODY.t: Administratori mogu instalirati softver za sve, mijenjati sustav i upravljati računima.

IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_ACCOUNTS_FAILED.t: Nešto nije u redu. Pokušajte ponovo.

IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_ACCOUNTS_LAST_ADMIN.en: This device needs at least one administrator
IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_ACCOUNTS_LAST_ADMIN.t: Ovaj uređaj mora imati barem jednog administratora

IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_ACCOUNTS_MAKE_ADMIN_.t: Želite li da NAME postane administrator?

IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_ACCOUNTS_NO_OTHER_PE.en: No one else has an account on this device.
IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_ACCOUNTS_NO_OTHER_PE.t: Nitko drugi nema račun na ovom uređaju.

IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_ACCOUNTS_OTHER_PEOPL.en: Everyone has their own account and files. Administrators can install software for everyone, change the system and manage accounts.
IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_ACCOUNTS_OTHER_PEOPL.t: Svatko ima vlastiti račun i datoteke. Administratori mogu instalirati softver za sve, mijenjati sustav i upravljati računima.

IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_ACCOUNTS_REMOVE_ADMI.t: Želite li da NAME postane standardni korisnik?

IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_ACCOUNTS_REMOVE_BODY.en: Their account and all their files are deleted from this device. This can't be undone.
IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_ACCOUNTS_REMOVE_BODY.t: Račun te osobe i sve njezine datoteke brišu se s ovog uređaja. To se ne može poništiti.

IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_ANDROID_ADMIN_ONLY.en: Only an administrator of this device can change these.
IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_ANDROID_ADMIN_ONLY.t: Ove postavke može mijenjati samo administrator ovog uređaja.

IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_ANDROID_ARM_DESCRIPT.en: For apps built only for the ARM processors phones use, many games among them. Proprietary software, downloaded when you turn it on.
IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_ANDROID_ARM_DESCRIPT.t: Za aplikacije izrađene samo za ARM procesore kakve upotrebljavaju telefoni, među kojima su i mnoge igre. Vlasnički softver, preuzima se kad ga uključite.

IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_ANDROID_ARM_DIALOG_B.en: Many Android apps, games especially, are built only for the ARM processors phones use. To run them on this computer, Android needs a translator. NickelOS doesn't make or include one: turning this on downloads TRANSLATOR from GitHub, the same copy the Waydroid community's waydroid_script installs.
IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_ANDROID_ARM_DIALOG_B.t: Mnoge Android aplikacije, osobito igre, izrađene su samo za ARM procesore kakve upotrebljavaju telefoni. Da bi ih pokrenuo na ovom računalu, Androidu je potreban prevoditelj. NickelOS ga ne izrađuje niti uključuje: kad ovo uključite, s GitHuba se preuzima TRANSLATOR, ista kopija koju instalira waydroid_script zajednice Waydroid.

IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_ANDROID_ARM_DIALOG_B.en: It's proprietary software, under its owner's terms, and you're the one installing it. Some apps may run slowly or not at all. Android restarts to use it.
IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_ANDROID_ARM_DIALOG_B.t: To je vlasnički softver na koji se primjenjuju uvjeti njegova vlasnika, a instalirate ga vi. Neke aplikacije možda će raditi sporo ili uopće neće raditi. Android se ponovno pokreće kako bi ga počeo upotrebljavati.

IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_ANDROID_ARM_DIALOG_T.t: Želite li uključiti podršku za ARM aplikacije?

IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_ANDROID_ERROR_DOWNLO.en: The download didn't finish. Check your connection, then try again.
IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_ANDROID_ERROR_DOWNLO.t: Preuzimanje nije dovršeno. Provjerite vezu, a zatim pokušajte ponovo.

IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_ANDROID_ERROR_FAILED.t: Nešto nije u redu. Pokušajte ponovo.

IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_ANDROID_REMOVE_DESCR.en: Deletes Android, your Android apps and their data
IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_ANDROID_REMOVE_DESCR.t: Briše Android, vaše Android aplikacije i njihove podatke

IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_ANDROID_REMOVE_DIALO.en: Android, your Android apps and their data are deleted from this device. Other people who use it keep their Android data, but can't open their Android apps until Android is set up again.
IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_ANDROID_REMOVE_DIALO.t: Android, vaše Android aplikacije i njihovi podaci brišu se s ovog uređaja. Ostali korisnici ovog uređaja zadržavaju svoje Android podatke, ali ne mogu otvarati svoje Android aplikacije dok se Android ponovno ne postavi.

IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_ANDROID_SET_UP_DESCR.en: Android apps open in their own windows, next to your other apps. Setting up downloads Android (LineageOS, from the Waydroid project): about 1 GB, and 2.5 GB on this device.
IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_ANDROID_SET_UP_DESCR.t: Android aplikacije otvaraju se u vlastitim prozorima, uz vaše ostale aplikacije. Postavljanjem se preuzima Android (LineageOS, iz projekta Waydroid): oko 1 GB, a na ovom uređaju zauzima 2,5 GB.

IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_ANDROID_UNAVAILABLE.en: Android apps aren't available right now.

IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_ANDROID_USES.en: Android uses SIZE on this device
IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_ANDROID_USES.t: Android zauzima SIZE na ovom uređaju

IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_CLOUD_DESCRIPTION.en: See Google Drive, OneDrive, Dropbox and other cloud storage in Files
IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_CLOUD_DESCRIPTION.t: Pregledavajte Google disk, OneDrive, Dropbox i drugu pohranu u oblaku u Datotekama

IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_CLOUD_DRIVE_HELP.en: Google Drive needs your own client ID and secret from the Google Cloud console.
IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_CLOUD_DRIVE_HELP.t: Za Google disk potrebni su vaš vlastiti ID klijenta i tajni ključ s konzole Google Cloud.

IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_CLOUD_FAILED.en: Couldn't connect. Check the details and try again.
IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_CLOUD_FAILED.t: Povezivanje nije uspjelo. Provjerite podatke i pokušajte ponovo.

IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_CLOUD_RCLONE.en: NickelOS uses rclone to show your cloud storage in Files, so your files are easy to reach. Choose a service to sign in to.
IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_CLOUD_RCLONE.t: NickelOS upotrebljava rclone za prikaz pohrane u oblaku u Datotekama kako bi vam datoteke bile lako dostupne. Odaberite uslugu na koju se želite prijaviti.

IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_CLOUD_REMOVE_BODY.en: Files stops showing this account. Your files stay in the cloud, and you can add the account again later.
IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_CLOUD_REMOVE_BODY.t: Aplikacija Datoteke više neće prikazivati taj račun. Vaše datoteke ostaju u oblaku, a račun možete ponovo dodati kasnije.

IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_CLOUD_SIGNING_IN.en: Finish signing in on the page that opened in your browser.
IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_CLOUD_SIGNING_IN.t: Dovršite prijavu na stranici koja se otvorila u pregledniku.

IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_CLOUD_SIGN_IN_NOTE.en: When you connect, the service's sign-in page opens in your browser.
IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_CLOUD_SIGN_IN_NOTE.t: Kada se povežete, stranica za prijavu na uslugu otvorit će se u pregledniku.

IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_CLOUD_TWO_FACTOR.t: Kôd za potvrdu u dva koraka (ako je upotrebljavate)

IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_COMPUTER_NAME_ADMIN_.en: Only an administrator of this computer can change its name.
IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_COMPUTER_NAME_ADMIN_.t: Naziv ovog računala može promijeniti samo njegov administrator.

IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_COMPUTER_NAME_DIALOG.en: Other devices see this name on your network and over Bluetooth, and the Terminal and Linux apps show it.
IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_COMPUTER_NAME_DIALOG.t: Drugi uređaji vide taj naziv na vašoj mreži i putem Bluetootha, a prikazuju ga i Terminal i Linux aplikacije.

IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_COMPUTER_NAME_FAILED.en: The name couldn't be changed. Try again.
IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_COMPUTER_NAME_FAILED.t: Naziv nije moguće promijeniti. Pokušajte ponovo.

IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_COMPUTER_NAME_INVALI.en: Use at least one letter from A to Z or a number.
IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_COMPUTER_NAME_INVALI.t: Upotrijebite barem jedno slovo od A do Z ili broj.

IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_DEFAULT_APPS_DESCRIP.en: The apps that open each kind of file, from Files and from Linux apps
IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_DEFAULT_APPS_DESCRIP.t: Aplikacije koje otvaraju pojedinu vrstu datoteke iz Datoteka i iz Linux aplikacija

IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_DEFAULT_APPS_NONE.t: Nijedna aplikacija ne otvara ove datoteke

IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_DRIVES_DESCRIPTION.en: Drives inside this device besides the one with NickelOS. The drive that holds Windows opens read-only, so Windows stays intact.
IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_DRIVES_DESCRIPTION.t: Diskovi u ovom uređaju osim onog na kojem je NickelOS. Disk na kojem je Windows otvara se samo za čitanje kako bi Windows ostao netaknut.

IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_DRIVE_ALLOW_CHANGES_.en: Windows is on this drive. It's read-only unless you allow changes.
IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_DRIVE_ALLOW_CHANGES_.t: Na ovom je disku Windows. Disk je samo za čitanje ako ne dopustite promjene.

IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_DRIVE_DIALOG_BODY.en: With Fast Startup, Windows doesn't fully shut down, and changes made here can be lost or damage files when Windows starts again. Turn off Fast Startup in Windows, or hold Shift while you shut Windows down, before you make changes.
IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_DRIVE_DIALOG_BODY.t: Uz brzo pokretanje Windows se ne isključuje potpuno, pa se promjene napravljene ovdje mogu izgubiti ili oštetiti datoteke kad se Windows ponovno pokrene. Prije unošenja promjena isključite brzo pokretanje u Windowsu ili držite Shift dok isključujete Windows.

IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_DRIVE_DIALOG_TITLE.en: Allow changes to the Windows drive?
IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_DRIVE_DIALOG_TITLE.t: Želite li dopustiti promjene na disku sa sustavom Windows?

IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_DRIVE_HIBERNATED.en: Windows didn't shut down fully, so the drive stays read-only. Shut down Windows fully to make changes.
IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_DRIVE_HIBERNATED.t: Windows nije potpuno isključen, pa disk ostaje samo za čitanje. Potpuno isključite Windows da biste mogli unositi promjene.

IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_HELP_COMMUNITY_DESCR.en: The forum, Discord and GitHub, on nickelos.dev
IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_HELP_COMMUNITY_DESCR.t: Forum, Discord i GitHub na nickelos.dev

IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_HELP_GENTOO_DESCRIPT.en: Portage and emerge from the start, with pacman and apt commands side by side
IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_HELP_GENTOO_DESCRIPT.t: Portage i emerge od samog početka, uz usporedne naredbe za pacman i apt

IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_HELP_GUIDE_DESCRIPTI.en: How NickelOS works. This copy came with your version of NickelOS and works offline.
IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_HELP_GUIDE_DESCRIPTI.t: Kako funkcionira NickelOS. Ova je kopija stigla s vašom verzijom NickelOS-a i dostupna je i bez internetske veze.

IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_HELP_MENU_ITEM_DESCR.t: Vodič, učenje sustava Gentoo, rješavanje problema

IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_HELP_TROUBLESHOOTING.en: Logs, crash reports, and the usual problems and their fixes
IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_HELP_TROUBLESHOOTING.t: Zapisnici, izvješća o rušenju te uobičajeni problemi i njihova rješenja

IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_PHONES_DESCRIPTION.en: With the KDE Connect app on Android or iPhone, on the same Wi‑Fi network
IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_PHONES_DESCRIPTION.t: Pomoću aplikacije KDE Connect na Androidu ili iPhoneu, na istoj Wi-Fi mreži

IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_PHONES_NONE.en: No phones or tablets yet. Install KDE Connect from Google Play, F‑Droid or the App Store, open it on the same Wi‑Fi network, then pair from either device.
IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_PHONES_NONE.t: Još nema telefona ni tableta. Instalirajte KDE Connect s Google Playa, F-Droida ili App Storea, otvorite ga na istoj Wi-Fi mreži, a zatim pokrenite uparivanje s bilo kojeg od dvaju uređaja.

IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_PHONES_NOT_RUNNING.en: The phone connection isn't running. Sign out and back in to start it.
IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_PHONES_NOT_RUNNING.t: Veza s telefonom nije pokrenuta. Odjavite se i ponovo se prijavite da biste je pokrenuli.

IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_PHONES_WANTS_TO_PAIR.en: Wants to pair with this device
IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_PHONES_WANTS_TO_PAIR.t: Želi se upariti s ovim uređajem

IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_X11_KEYS_DESCRIPTION.en: Lets apps such as Discord use push-to-talk while you're in other windows. They see keys pressed with Ctrl, Alt or Search and function keys, never what you type.
IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_X11_KEYS_DESCRIPTION.t: Omogućuje aplikacijama kao što je Discord da upotrebljavaju funkciju „pritisni za razgovor” dok ste u drugim prozorima. Te aplikacije vide tipke pritisnute uz Ctrl, Alt ili tipku za pretraživanje i funkcijske tipke, ali nikad ono što upisujete.

IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_X11_KEYS_LABEL.en: Shortcut keys for older Linux apps
IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_X11_KEYS_LABEL.t: Tipkovni prečaci za starije Linux aplikacije

IDS_SETTINGS_PRINTING_CUPS_HELP_SECTION_.en: Make sure your printer is connected to the same Wi-Fi network as your NickelOS device or use a USB cable. LINK_BEGINLearn more about compatibilityLINK_END
IDS_SETTINGS_PRINTING_CUPS_HELP_SECTION_.t: Pisač mora biti povezan s istom Wi-Fi mrežom kao i NickelOS uređaj ili upotrijebite USB kabel. LINK_BEGINSaznajte više o kompatibilnostiLINK_END

IDS_SETTINGS_PRINTING_CUPS_PRINTER_ADDED.en: Can’t connect to printer. Check that the printer is turned on and is connected to your NickelOS device by Wi-Fi or USB.
IDS_SETTINGS_PRINTING_CUPS_PRINTER_ADDED.t: Povezivanje s pisačem nije uspjelo. Provjerite je li pisač uključen i povezan s NickelOS uređajem putem Wi-Fi mreže ili USB-a.

IDS_SETTINGS_SWITCH_ACCESS_SETUP_INTRO_B.en: To get started, please make sure your USB or Bluetooth switch is connected to your NickelOS device. You can also use keyboard keys.
IDS_SETTINGS_SWITCH_ACCESS_SETUP_INTRO_B.t: Da biste započeli, provjerite je li USB ili Bluetooth prekidač povezan s NickelOS uređajem. Možete upotrijebiti i tipke tipkovnice.

IDS_SMART_LOCK_LABEL_LOOKING_FOR_PHONE.en: To unlock your NickelOS device, make sure your phone's Bluetooth is on
IDS_SMART_LOCK_LABEL_LOOKING_FOR_PHONE.t: Da biste otključali NickelOS uređaj, provjerite je li na telefonu uključen Bluetooth

IDS_SMART_LOCK_LABEL_NO_BLUETOOTH.en: Your NickelOS device’s Bluetooth is off. To unlock your NickelOS device, enter password.
IDS_SMART_LOCK_LABEL_NO_BLUETOOTH.t: Bluetooth na NickelOS uređaju je isključen. Da biste otključali NickelOS uređaj, unesite zaporku.

IDS_SMART_LOCK_LABEL_NO_PHONE_LOCK_SCREE.en: Your phone doesn’t have a lock screen. To unlock your NickelOS device, enter password.
IDS_SMART_LOCK_LABEL_NO_PHONE_LOCK_SCREE.t: Telefon nema zaključani zaslon. Da biste otključali NickelOS uređaj, unesite zaporku.

IDS_SMART_LOCK_LABEL_PHONE_LOCKED.en: To unlock your NickelOS device, first unlock your phone
IDS_SMART_LOCK_LABEL_PHONE_LOCKED.t: Da biste otključali NickelOS uređaj, najprije otključajte telefon

IDS_SMART_PRIVACY_PROTECTION_CONTENT.en: Your device uses a built-in sensor to detect people in front of it. All data is processed on your device immediately and then deleted. Sensor data is never sent to Google.
IDS_SMART_PRIVACY_PROTECTION_CONTENT.t: Uređaj koristi ugrađeni senzor kako bi detektirao osobe ispred sebe. Svi se podaci odmah obrađuju na uređaju, a zatim brišu. Podaci senzora nikad se ne šalju Googleu.

IDS_SYNC_OTHER_SIGN_IN_ERROR_BUBBLE_VIEW.en: NickelOS could not sync your data due to an error signing in.
IDS_SYNC_OTHER_SIGN_IN_ERROR_BUBBLE_VIEW.t: NickelOS nije mogao sinkronizirati vaše podatke zbog pogreške prilikom prijave.

IDS_SYNC_OTHER_SIGN_IN_ERROR_BUBBLE_VIEW.en: NickelOS could not save Chromium data in your Google Account due to an error signing in
IDS_SYNC_OTHER_SIGN_IN_ERROR_BUBBLE_VIEW.t: NickelOS nije mogao spremiti podatke iz Chromiuma na vaš Google račun zbog pogreške prilikom prijave

IDS_SYNC_SIGN_IN_ERROR_BUBBLE_VIEW_MESSA.en: NickelOS could not sync your data because your account sign-in details are out of date.
IDS_SYNC_SIGN_IN_ERROR_BUBBLE_VIEW_MESSA.t: NickelOS nije mogao sinkronizirati podatke vašeg računa jer su podaci prijave na račun zastarjeli.

IDS_SYNC_SIGN_IN_ERROR_BUBBLE_VIEW_MESSA.en: NickelOS could not save Chromium data in your Google Account because your account sign-in details are out of date
IDS_SYNC_SIGN_IN_ERROR_BUBBLE_VIEW_MESSA.t: NickelOS nije mogao spremiti podatke iz Chromiuma na vaš Google račun jer su podaci za prijavu na račun zastarjeli

IDS_SYNC_UNAVAILABLE_ERROR_BUBBLE_VIEW_M.en: NickelOS could not sync your data because Sync is not available for your domain.
IDS_SYNC_UNAVAILABLE_ERROR_BUBBLE_VIEW_M.t: NickelOS nije mogao sinkronizirati vaše podatke jer sinkronizacija nije dostupna za vašu domenu.

IDS_TERMS_OF_SERVICE_SCREEN_SUBHEADING.en: MANAGER requires that you read and accept the following Terms of Service before using this device. These terms do not expand, modify or limit the NickelOS Terms.
IDS_TERMS_OF_SERVICE_SCREEN_SUBHEADING.t: MANAGER zahtijeva da pročitate i prihvatite sljedeće uvjete pružanja usluge prije upotrebe ovog uređaja. Ti uvjeti ne predstavljaju proširenje, izmjenu ili ograničenje uvjeta NickelOS-a.

IDS_UPDATE_RECOMMENDED.en: NickelOS needs to be restarted to apply the update.
IDS_UPDATE_RECOMMENDED.t: Potrebno je ponovo pokrenuti NickelOS kako bi se ažuriranje primijenilo.

IDS_UPDATE_SLIDE_ACCOUNT_TEXT.en: You’ll sign in to your device with your own account, and everyone who uses it can have one.
IDS_UPDATE_SLIDE_ACCOUNT_TEXT.t: Na uređaj se prijavljujete vlastitim računom, a svatko tko ga upotrebljava može imati svoj.

IDS_UPDATE_SLIDE_ACCOUNT_TITLE.en: Your own account on your device

IDS_UPDATE_SLIDE_ANTIVIRUS_TEXT.en: NickelOS is designed with security in mind, and it keeps itself up to date automatically.
IDS_UPDATE_SLIDE_ANTIVIRUS_TEXT.t: NickelOS je osmišljen s naglaskom na sigurnost i sam se automatski ažurira.

IDS_UPDATE_SLIDE_APPS_TEXT.en: NickelOS runs web apps and Linux apps side by side. Get apps for productivity, entertainment, and more.
IDS_UPDATE_SLIDE_APPS_TEXT.t: NickelOS pokreće web-aplikacije i Linux aplikacije jedne uz druge. Preuzmite aplikacije za produktivnost, zabavu i mnoge druge.

IDS_UPDATE_SLIDE_UPDATE_TEXT.en: This is the only time you’ll wait for an update. On NickelOS, software updates happen in the background.
IDS_UPDATE_SLIDE_UPDATE_TEXT.t: Ovo je jedini put da ćete čekati na ažuriranje. Na NickelOS-u se ažuriranja softvera odvijaju u pozadini.

IDS_USER_INSTALLED_CHROME_APP_DEPRECATIO.en: Chrome apps don’t run on NickelOS. Consider an alternative app.
IDS_USER_INSTALLED_CHROME_APP_DEPRECATIO.t: Chromeove aplikacije ne pokreću se na NickelOS-u. Upotrijebite alternativnu aplikaciju.

IDS_WRONG_HWID_SCREEN_MESSAGE_FIRST_PART.en: Unfortunately, your computer is configured with a malformed hardware ID. This prevents NickelOS from updating with the latest security fixes and your computer BEGIN_BOLDmay be vulnerable to malicious attacksEND_BOLD.
IDS_WRONG_HWID_SCREEN_MESSAGE_FIRST_PART.t: Nažalost, vaše je računalo konfigurirano s pogrešno oblikovanim ID-jem hardvera. To sprječava ažuriranje NickelOS-a najnovijim sigurnosnim popravcima, pa bi vaše računalo BEGIN_BOLDmoglo biti ranjivo na zlonamjerne napadeEND_BOLD.
